name: A3!
source:
You're a former actress who, in a sudden turn of events, becomes the director of a theater troupe on its last legs! It's up to you to find fresh new faces to bring the Mankai Company back to its original glory, but here’s the catch⁠— you only have 1 year and 4 performances to do so! Will you see your actors shining live on that stage? The fate of this theater is in your hands!

Get a behind the scenes look at the ups and downs of the life of fledgling actors as they work through their own personal drama and forge relationships that shine on and off the stage! Whether you love comedy, drama or action, this story has it all in spades!

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1479369663?mt=8]App Store[/url]]
translation:
你是一名前演员，突然变故，成为了一个濒临破产的剧团的导演！你需要寻找新鲜的新面孔，让曼凯公司恢复原来的辉煌，但有一个问题⁠——你只有1年零4场表演的时间来做到这一点！你会看到你的演员在那个舞台上闪闪发光吗？这个剧院的命运掌握在你的手中！

深入幕后，了解初出茅庐的演员们在演绎自己的个人戏剧并在台上和台下建立闪耀的关系时，生活的起起落落！无论你喜欢喜剧、剧情片还是动作片，这个故事都能满足你的需求！

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/app/id1479369663?mt=8]App Store[/url]]
